text:
sasha: incident-bot just fired a page for AstraMed dedicated cluster (reserved pool saturation) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8275 triggered for eng-oncall — priority: P1 — reason: tenant_reserved_capacity_throttle_count > 50 in 5m. Link: https://pd.example/PD-8275
pagerduty-bot: page sent to on-call (sasha). Please acknowledge.
sasha: acked. I'm taking this. Seeing a spike in queue wait for tenant astramed-reserved-1. Metrics: tail latency up to 2.4s, 429s for some requests.
maria: noticed errors in logs: "KV cache miss fallback" entries and a lot of requests hitting fallback model variant.
sasha: copying logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T15:02:10Z astra-req id=abcd1234 status=429 reason=reserved_pool_exhausted pool=astra-reserved-1
2026-03-14T15:02:11Z astra-req id=abcd1235 kv_cache=miss fallback_variant=m-medium latency_ms=2400
```

derek: is this correlated with any deploy? I don't see a deployment alert.
sasha: no deploys in last hour per deploy-bot. Looks like traffic spike from customer batch job + degraded autoscale response on that pool.
ryan: I'm seeing GPU util at 98% on two nodes in the pool, kube-scaler didn't spin up extra pods — HPA didn't trigger because pod priority preemption prevented new reserved pods from scheduling.
maria: triage plan: 1) temporarily increase reserved pool burst size, 2) enable willing-fallback to host routing to a compatible pool (if safe), 3) notify customer.
sasha: executing step 1 now: `rctl reserved update astra-reserved-1 --burst-capacity 3`
sasha: update: burst increase applied, starting to drain queue slowly. Error rate dropping from 18% -> 6% in 2m.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8275: acknowledged by sasha. Escalation scheduled in 8 minutes if not resolved.
derek: I'll take step 2 — add a soft-route rule to allow requests to fallback to astra-reserved-2 with model-compat check. Command I'm running: ```
routerctl add-rule --from astra-reserved-1 --to astra-reserved-2 --policy=soft-fallback --check=model-compat
```
derek: rule applied, traffic starting to flow to reserved-2 (capacity 40% free).
maria: customer impact assessment: approx 900 requests failed over 10m window, majority retries succeeded. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate (model: open-medium). Estimated customers impacted: AstraMed production app only (no other tenants).
sasha: notified customer via support: "We observed transient throttling on your dedicated cluster; we've applied burst capacity and temporary routing. Monitoring closely."
ryan: infra note: HPA issue root cause looks like the node auto-scaler drains can't allocate new instances due to AZ capacity spike — follow-up ticket created: INFRA-5621.
sasha: PD auto-escalation canceled — system shows recovery trend. I'll keep monitoring for 30m.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8275: status changed to resolved by sasha (mitigations applied, metrics stable).
maria: recording actions for postmortem: - burst increase cmd - soft-routing rule - support notification - INFRA-5621 link to autoscaler capacity issue
derek: follow-up immediate tasks: add a healthcheck on reserved HPA, add guard to prevent pod priority from blocking reserved pod scheduling.
sasha: handoff to derek for follow-through; I'm going off-shift in 20m. Derek, you own the postmortem and any customer RCA.
derek: got it. I'll open an incident write-up and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra.
ryan: adding a monitoring alert tweak: add saturation alert earlier at 60% queue length to avoid hitting the 90% critical threshold.
sasha: thanks all. Closing thread when derek confirms postmortem ticket. :thumbsup:
